definitions.gloss: dry and wet; dryness and humidity

notes:
{乾湿|かんしつ} refers to the state of dryness and wetness, or the range between dry and wet conditions. It combines {乾|かん} (dry) + {湿|しつ} (wet/humid).

COMPOUNDS:
- {乾湿計|かんしつけい}: hygrometer (wet-and-dry bulb thermometer)
- {乾湿|かんしつ}{両用|りょうよう}: for both wet and dry use
- {乾湿|かんしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference between dry and wet conditions

USAGE:
- Weather and climate descriptions
- Scientific measurements
- Appliance features (vacuums, mops)
